scope.text: Calculus; f continuous over [a,b]; F(x)=∫_a^x f(t)dt
scope.basis: as-stated for continuity/definition; broader calculus scope inferred

text: If f(x) is continuous over an interval [a,b], and the function F(x) is defined by F(x)=∫_a^x f(t)dt, then F′(x)=f(x) over (a,b).
notes: Part 1 of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus. Source proof in blocks p-42–p-45; reusable proof method recorded as procedure:prove-ftc-part1.
